component.name: Westering
component.summary: A few quiet minutes under tonight's real sky

description.p: Westering is a few quiet minutes at the end of the day, to wind down and come back to what matters to you. It draws the real sky over you tonight in fine dots: the stars, the Moon at its real phase, and the planets that are really up. Find a few things, hear a story, and set down what's weighing on you, to watch it go down in the west with the turning sky. Each visit slows as you go, dims for a real reason, and ends by naming something you can go outside and see.

ul.li: The sky is worked out on your computer from your time zone: no location service
A few things to find each night, and then the sky is done until it turns
Set down what's weighing on you, and watch it set in the west
A logbook kept as plain files you can read, copy or delete
No network access at all: nothing you write leaves your computer

description.p: Every evening shows its three parts: set it down, look up, wind down. Winding down is chosen, and ends outside or in bed.
Constellation figures from Stellarium's modern set, and hints for what's under the pointer.
Night Sky is now Westering. Your logbook comes across the first time it opens.
